name: Campaign 36C — Sparse cellular organism
objective: Test whether a growing Ninereeds organism can execute, learn, persist, restructure, and maintain itself through sparse local BDH-derived tissue whose ordinary compute scales with recruited tissue rather than total stored capacity.

campaign_contract.development_stage: architecture-validation laboratories for a sparse cellular organism
campaign_contract.purpose: Falsify the essential execution, learning, growth, persistence, structural, and metabolic claims of Campaign 36C in dependency order before authorizing a full organism bootstrap.
success_criteria: Only locally reached tissue executes full transformations, and disconnected cold tissue does not materially change ordinary forward cost or output.
Typed delayed credit changes useful executed routes while inactive tissue remains byte-identical and black-swan evidence survives.
New tissue is admitted only after persistent coherent capacity evidence and a shadow trial demonstrates independent value without established-route regression.
Packed persistence, cold resume, structural transactions, quarantine, same-UID revival, and authorized purge preserve identity across every tested crash boundary.
The final integration stage demonstrates the implemented mechanisms together without introducing a global semantic router or dense population execution.
failure_criteria: A thought scores or executes the full tissue population, or a global semantic router chooses its route.
Inactive tissue, unrelated optimizer state, or unowned parameters change during local learning.
High loss or novelty alone allocates tissue, or established routes are damaged by an admitted birth.
Crash recovery loses UID identity, topology, optimizer ownership, quarantine state, aliases, or permanent retirement.
Metabolic cleanup deletes tissue during inference or permits mutual background chatter to manufacture rooted usefulness.
expected_regressions: Small resident-transformer tasks may be faster than sparse paged execution; the speed claim concerns serviceability and capacity-independent ordinary work.
Early routes may fan out broadly, reopen, or require more recurrent effort before structural familiarity develops.
A provisional cell, fusion, or revival candidate may be rejected without invalidating the substrate.
The standalone Stage-1 cell result remains provisional because its equal-cost extra-core-tick comparator was not completed.
campaign_contract.hypothesis: A continuously growing population of independently stored BDH-derived cells can form one locally communicating organism whose useful routes learn and mature while ordinary compute remains tied principally to recruited tissue rather than lifetime capacity.
observations_sought: Active UID count, frontier width, recurrent effort, page traffic, and latency as total stored tissue grows.
Exact parameter and optimizer ownership under delayed local credit.
Residual coherence, shadow value, neighbor acceptance, and regression around birth and revival decisions.
Packing benefit, fusion maturity, fission limits, senescence, quarantine, revival, purge, and crash recovery.
Whether the integrated organism preserves sparse behavior when all implemented mechanisms interact.

current_stage.purpose: Run the frozen 3,022-word visual bootstrap through the integrated 25M continuity core and sparse organism with full-organism rollback snapshots.

stage_evidence.note: Independent width-512 cell behavior was established; the equal-cost extra-core-tick comparator remains missing.
